newsitem.title: USA: HS Resources files $300 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: HS Resources files $300 mln shelf.

text.p: HS Resources Inc Wednesday filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $300 million in debt securities and preferred and common stock and warrants.

Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include refinancing, or repayments of indebtedness, capital expenditures, working capital, acquistions and repurchases and redemptions of securities. HSE Resources, based in San Francisco, Calif., is an independent energy company engaged in the development, acquisition, exploration, exploitation, production and marketing of oil and natural gas.
